In the background, there is a brightly lit playground with primary-colored structures. (2) The camera moves closer as she continues her walk along a low concrete barrier decorated with diamond patterns. She turns her head slightly, revealing her side profile and a small earring. The lighting is dominated by tall streetlamps casting a warm, yellowish glow on the pavement and surroundings. (3) She stops and turns fully toward the camera, her face clearly lit by artificial light. She has a joyful expression with a wide smile and squinted eyes, covering her mouth with her right hand while laughing. Parked cars and distant streetlights are visible in the far background. (4) She continues to walk forward, glancing back over her shoulder repeatedly with a mischievous and happy smile. Her hands move naturally by her side as she interacts with the person filming. The background changes to show more park greenery and white benches under the night sky.
